items.information:
## Esta competição terá Dual Rounds.
 **Resultados em direto não estão no WCA Live, deve usar [Resultados em Direto](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2026/live)**
 
 **Em caso de problemas técnicos, o formato de Dual Rounds não será utilizado.**

Se vais competir pela primeira vez, certifica-te que lês todas as informações em [Informação Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2026#54123-informacao-importante-important-information), [Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2026#54122-perguntas-frequentes-faq) e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
Se és associado da APS tens direito a um desconto exclusivo de 20%, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2025#54121-associados-aps-aps-associates).
​
## This competition will have Dual Rounds.
 **Live results won't appear on WCA Live, you should use [Live Results](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2026/live)**
 
**There is a possibility Dual Rounds won't be used, as this format is being tested and technical issues may appear.**

If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2026#68468-informacao-importante-important-information), the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2026#68469-perguntas-frequentes-faq) and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an exclusive 20% discount, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2026#68473-associados-aps-aps-associates).

items.information:

**OBS:** Maximalt en gäst / medföljande per deltagare på grund av tävlingslokalens storlek. Ingen utomstående publik tillåten.

--

Welcome to Cooldown Uppsala 2026! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

**N.B.:** Maximum one guest / accompanying person per competitors due to the size of the competition venue. No external visitors allowed.

items.information:
* Please review all of the tabs listed on this website.

* This competition is a part of the Cubing at Vivira 2026 Competition series. 

* Other competition in this series is [Cubing at Vivira B 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingatViviraB2026)

* Note: **You will only be allowed to compete in one of the Series competitions!**

* The events will happen in the order listed on the "Schedule" tab, but event durations are tentative! Check back the day before the competition, as event durations may change depending on the number of competitors in events.

* Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance just in case

* We won't be allowing late entry in the competition under any exceptions. Make sure you will be available at the venue when your name is called.

* Make sure you go through all the WCA regulations.

* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or unaware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session.

* Participants must bring their own cubes.

Happy Cubing! :)

EN:
You are invited to PSS Side Day Gdańsk 2026 — a one-day competition organized by the Polish Speedcubing Association, focused on less popular events. The competition features 3 attempts of FMC, Megaminx, 4x4x4 BLD, 5x5x5 BLD, and as many as three rounds of 3x3x3 BLD. **The competition is not part of the Gdańsk Speedcubing League (GLS).**

**English** We are pleased to announce the first speedcubing competition at the Pontificia Universidad Católica de Valparaíso in 2026. We hope to welcome as many competitors as possible and make this an exciting event for competitors, family, and friends. We look forward to seeing you there!

items.name: Welcome Back Hamilton 2026

venue.name: The Hardy Centre
venue.address: Hardy Guide Centre 18 Hungerford Crescent, Hamilton East, Hamilton 3216

items.information:
Hamilton Open 2026 is an official World Cubing Association (WCA) competition. Events include 3x3x3 (Main Event), 2x2x2, 4x4x4, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Clock and Pyraminx. This will be the first WCA competition located in Hamilton in over 3 years. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc2NDY5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d078d15b6540b94b4288eb606c6e20a262b8ab41/image.png)

items.name: Westview Spring 2026
items.information:
# Westview Spring 2026 is CANCELLED due to venue issues. Please check your email.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WestviewSpring2026#74042-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).
